s.zh: \n知识回馈：技能固定，不会因工作、学习或衰减改变；工作中本该获得的经验（按自身兴趣与学习倍率）100%传给主人对应技能，不重复乘算主人学习倍率。\n状态：
s.en: \nKnowledge feedback: skills are fixed and don't change from work, learning or decay; XP that work should have given (by own passions and learning multiplier) goes 100% to the master's matching skill, without applying the master's learning multiplier again.\nStatus:

s.zh: 暂停（休眠或统御失效，经验不传递）
s.en: paused (dormant or command lost; XP isn't passed on)
